description: Get Bitcoin cycle performance data. Shows price progression indexed from cycle reference points (lows, ATHs, halvings). Without type parameter returns aggregate cycle comparison; with type returns individual cycle tracks.

days.description: Number of daily data points to return

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides days param when set.

type.description: Cycle reference point type: "low", "ath", or "halving". Omit for aggregate comparison.

name: get_cycle_performance
